opening.quote: Good after noon, thank you calling Tidewell Home, brown speaking.
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name, which meets the opening standard, though the greeting was garbled in transcription and should be spoken clearly.

verification.quote: Done, I've updated a account to eva.smit@example.com.
verification.comment: You changed the account email without first confirming the caller's full name and an order number or account postcode, which is required before changing account data.

understanding.quote: Customer: Hi brum. I'd like it to change so the email address on account, I do use the one any more.
understanding.comment: You captured both the email change and the order enquiry, and did not ask for information already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: your lamp shipp this morning and arrives you know in 2 to 4 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The 2 to 4 working day standard delivery timeline matches policy, but you also misrecorded the new email address as eva.smit when the caller said efa.smit, which is an inaccurate account change.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Done, I've updated a account to eva.smit@example.com. you next order will gos there.
process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo/return steps applied, so the only relevant check is data handling, but the email was changed without the required identity verification step.

communication.comment: The caller showed no frustration, and you were polite and helpful throughout the call.

closing.comment: The call ended without you confirming next steps or asking if there was anything else, so please close by summarising what happens next and asking if the caller needs anything more.
